product.name: Evidence Desk
product.oneSentence: Let a person and an agent inspect, select, and annotate the same evidence records without changing their observed status.
audience: Researchers and maintainers reviewing evidence with an agent
product.sharedArtifact: A selected sample evidence record and revisioned annotations persisted in browser storage.

humanWorkflow.entrypoint: Select a record, inspect its evidence state, then attach a factual annotation.
humanWorkflow.visibleFeedback: The selected detail region, annotations, revision, and activity record update from the canonical desk store.

capabilities.userJourney: Inspect all sample records, their evidence states, the selected record, annotations, and revision.

ui.humanEntrypoint: Read the record index and selected detail.

resultContract.summary: Return all evidence records, the selected record, annotations, and revision.

successEvidence: The returned selected record and revision match the visible desk.

capabilities.userJourney: Make one named evidence record the shared visible selection.

ui.humanEntrypoint: Activate a record in the evidence index.
ui.visibleEffect: The bounded detail region displays the selected record and its unchanged evidence state.

resultContract.summary: Return the selected record identity, unchanged evidence state, and committed revision.

successEvidence: The returned record is the visibly selected record.

capabilities.userJourney: Attach one factual note to a named record without promoting or resolving its evidence state.

ui.humanEntrypoint: Submit the labelled annotation form for the selected record.
ui.visibleEffect: The note appears under the selected record and the revision advances; the record status does not change.

resultContract.summary: Return the record identity, saved annotation, unchanged evidence state, annotation count, and committed revision.

successEvidence: The returned annotation appears under the named record.
The record evidence state remains unchanged at the returned revision.
